name: Observability and actionable alerting

steps.action: Collect metrics and redacted logs with owners
Create availability, freshness, queue and resource panels
Route actionable alerts and runbook references
Test alert delivery outside marketing dispatch

gate: Failure signal and notification path tested?
output: Operational dashboards and accountable alert routes
failure: Stop the change, preserve source and rollback generation, keep destination isolated, record the failed acceptance check in OpenProject. No broad restart, pruning, privilege bypass, or automatic scope expansion.

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
